h1:
10 Apartment-Style Stays
in Pattaya, Chonburi
That We've Reviewed
heroSub: 10 hand-picked apartment-style stays and condos with kitchens in Pattaya that we've reviewed in depth — sea-view studios on Jomtien Beach, apartments on Wong Amat Beach, resort condos with great pools, and serviced apartments with kitchens in the city centre. Prices from around ฿700–2,500/night.
introH2: 🏙️ How many kinds of apartment-style stays does Pattaya have, and how do you pick the right one?
introHtml: The word "apartment" doesn't mean just one thing in Pattaya, and that's exactly what makes choosing this kind of stay here more interesting than a regular hotel — some are sea-view studios on Jomtien Beach where opening the balcony door reveals the shoreline, some are apartments right on Wong Amat Beach where you can walk down to the sand in a minute, and some are serviced apartments with kitchens in the city centre where you can cook every meal yourself. What all 10 share is rooms that are larger than hotel rooms at similar prices, with an in-room kitchen — which makes them great for long stays, families, and groups of friends who want to save on food. But what many people don't realise is that most of these stays are condos or apartments rented out by various managers, not full-service hotels, so room and service standards vary from unit to unit. This article rounds up 10 apartment-style stays in Pattaya that we've reviewed in depth, both beachfront and in-town — every one drawn from reading real guest reviews, telling you the upsides and the honest caveats alike, comparing prices across 3 sites, with direct booking links for all of them.
mrtHtml: Pattaya has no metro. The main way to get around is the blue songthaew (shared pickup truck) that loops the Pattaya–Jomtien route, with fares starting around 10 baht. Grabbing a Grab or renting a motorbike is convenient too. From Bangkok, Pattaya is about 1.5–2 hours by car. The areas where the apartment-style stays in this article are located: Jomtien Beach — a long beach that's quieter than central Pattaya, good for families, with several sea-view condos and resort condos with great pools · Wong Amat Beach (Naklua) — North Pattaya, with private beaches and a calm vibe, near Naklua Market for fresh seafood · Central Pattaya — near CentralFestival and Walking Street, with restaurants and entertainment all around · Pratumnak Hill–Thappraya — a hill between South Pattaya and Jomtien, quiet and private, near the pier to Koh Larn.

entries.type: Beachfront Condo · sea-view unit by the beach
entries.name: Sea View Beachfront Condos Pattaya Jomtien Beach
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.2 · 125 reviews · rental units by the beach
entries.badge: 🌊 Highest score · sea view by the beach
entries.addr: 459 Moo 12, Jomtien Beach Road, Nong Prue, Bang Lamung (Jomtien) · Pattaya
entries.storyHtml: If you're going to start a Pattaya apartment list with the highest-scoring stay of these 10, many reviews point us to Sea View Beachfront Condos Jomtien — units in a high-rise along the Jomtien beach road that sell the experience of having your own temporary sea-view condo more than a hotel room. The one thing every review agrees on is the sea view and the wide balcony — open the balcony door and you see the Jomtien shoreline stretching out, and the higher-floor units get an even more open, full view. The room itself is a studio with a sleeping area, a sitting area with a sofa, and a small built-in kitchen. Honest takes from real reviews say the usable space is noticeably larger than hotel rooms at similar prices, and the small kitchen genuinely saves on food costs for long stays. The building has a shared pool, security and CCTV, plus free parking, which many say is reassuring. The location is an advantage because you can walk down to Jomtien Beach in a few steps, and this stretch of beach is long and quieter than central Pattaya, good for families. Honest caveats from the reviews: because it's a rental condo, not a full-service hotel, check-in depends on each unit's manager, so arrange a time in advance; some mention occasional insect issues, and at times the building has renovation work; and prices during high season and long holidays climb quickly. Bottom line: if you want to wake up to the sea on an affordable budget and have more space than a hotel room, this is the option the reviews score highest in this article.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a high-floor unit facing directly out to sea for the most open view · and always arrange a key-pickup time with the unit's manager before you travel, since there's no 24-hour front desk like a hotel.
pros: Sea view and wide balcony are the number-one selling point (from reviews)
Usable space larger than hotel rooms at similar prices, with a small in-room kitchen
Walk down to Jomtien Beach in a few steps, a long quiet beach good for families
Building has security, CCTV and free parking, reassuring
cons: It's a rental condo, not a hotel; check-in depends on each unit's manager
Some mention occasional insect issues, and at times the building has renovation work
Prices during high season and long holidays climb quickly (from reviews)

entries.type: Beachfront Serviced Apartment · right on Wong Amat Beach
entries.name: Sky Beach Apartment Pattaya
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.0 · 94 reviews · Sky Beach condo rentals
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Wong Amat Beach · Naklua · 1 min walk to the beach
entries.addr: 672 Soi Naklua 18, Pattaya-Naklua Road, Bang Lamung · Pattaya
entries.storyHtml: Among the apartment-style stays that are "truly on the beach" on a budget, Sky Beach Apartment is the one reviews mention most for its location — rental units in the Sky Beach condo on Wong Amat Beach, in the Naklua area of North Pattaya, where you can walk down to the sand in a minute. The number-one selling point is the private beach and large seafront pool, plus a gym, sauna and tennis court, which many say is more than the price warrants. The room itself is a studio of around 53 sqm with a kitchen corner and a semicircular balcony; the sea-facing units have a full Wong Amat view, and there are also 2–3 bedroom units of 106–123 sqm for families or larger groups of friends. Another thing reviews like is being near Naklua Market — you can walk over to buy fresh, well-priced seafood to cook in the kitchen — plus 24-hour security for peace of mind. The shared facilities are larger than the price would suggest, and many reviews say you get a seaside-holiday vibe that would normally cost a lot more. Honest caveats, said plainly: this is a rental unit in a condo built back in 1992, not a hotel, so room condition isn't guaranteed to be the same across units because each is managed separately — some are nicely renovated, some are still original, so always check the photos and reviews of the unit you'll book; the shared-area design is an older style that some find dated; service depends on each owner so it's inconsistent; and the Naklua location means relying on Grab or a motorbike when heading into central Pattaya. Best for those who value sleeping right on the beach on a light budget and want a seafront pool with a spacious room and kitchen, over the newness and consistency of a chain-hotel room.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pick a Sea View unit facing out to sea for a full view from the semicircular balcony · and stop by Naklua Market for fresh seafood to cook in the kitchen, saving money and getting that long-stay feel.
pros: On Wong Amat Beach, 1 min walk to the sand, with a private beach and large seafront pool
Gym, sauna, tennis all included at a budget-friendly stay (from reviews)
Spacious room with kitchen, near Naklua Market to buy fresh seafood to cook yourself
Good security with 24-hour guards
cons: Rental units in an old 1992 condo; room condition varies across units
The shared-area design is an older style, some find it dated
The Naklua location means relying on Grab or a motorbike to head into town

entries.type: Self-Catering Apartment · low-rise condo by the beach
entries.name: View Talay Residence 6 Wongamat Beach
entries.badge: 🍳 Spacious room with kitchen · lots of reviews
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Wong Amat Beach · North Pattaya · ~300 m walk to the beach
entries.addr: 500/136 Moo 5, Naklua Road Soi 18, Naklua, Bang Lamung · Pattaya
entries.storyHtml: If Sky Beach is the "most on the beach," View Talay Residence 6 Wongamat is the one reviews call the "best value" in the spacious-room-with-kitchen-near-the-beach group — a 77-unit low-rise condo by Wong Amat Beach, managed by PSR, with as many as 300 reviews, the most of any beachfront stay in this article. The thing every review agrees on is rooms as spacious as a private condo, with a kitchen, sofa and built-in dining corner, which makes it feel more like having your own place than a hotel room. The in-room kitchen genuinely saves on food costs during long stays, especially when you can walk to Naklua Market for fresh ingredients. The location is about a 300 m walk to Wong Amat Beach, and the area is quiet and calm; reviews say it's good for families wanting to escape the bustle of central Pattaya. There's a shared pool and free parking, and several of the managers are praised as friendly and helpful. Honest caveats: because it's an apartment rented out by various managers, there's no full 24-hour hotel service, so confirm your check-in time in advance; each owner's room is decorated and equipped differently, so check the photos and reviews of the unit carefully before booking; and it's away from the main nightlife, so you'll need a ride out. Best for families and long-stayers who want spacious space with a kitchen in a quiet beach area.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Read the reviews and look at the photos of the unit you'll book carefully, since each room is managed separately and decorated differently · if you're coming as a family, pick Deluxe One-Bedroom or up for a clearly separate bedroom.
pros: Great value in the spacious-room-with-kitchen-near-the-beach group (from reviews)
In-room kitchen saves money on long stays, near Naklua Market
Location near Wong Amat Beach ~300 m, quiet and good for families
Has a shared pool, free parking, friendly managers

entries.type: Venice-themed Condo Resort · rooms with kitchens
entries.name: Venetian Pattaya
entries.revCount: Trip.com 6.3 · 60 reviews · rented unit by unit
entries.badge: 🛶 Gondola canal pool · lowest starting price
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Na Jomtien · ~5 min from the south end of Jomtien Beach
entries.addr: 194 Moo 1, Jomtien 2 Road, Na Jomtien, Sattahip · Pattaya
entries.storyHtml: Venetian Pattaya is the most unusual-looking stay in this article, and the one with the lowest starting price — a Venice-themed condo resort of 4 buildings and around 990 units in the Na Jomtien area, designed with a pool that imitates Venice's Grand Canal, complete with gondola boats for photos. The selling point is shared facilities packed in beyond the price — the Venice canal pool, a water park, gym, sauna and jacuzzi, which reviews say are fun for families with kids. Rooms range from 24–26 sqm studios up to 2-bedroom 60–64 sqm units, all with a kitchen corner and balcony, so you can cook to save money, and there's free parking, good for those driving themselves. But it has to be said plainly that the review score here is 6.3, the lowest in the article, and the reason is inconsistency — because it's a condo rented out unit by unit by various managers, some newly renovated units are clean, nice and good value, but some have stains, mould, or items not matching the photos; reaching the manager can be hard in some cases; Wi-Fi is weak in some units; and upkeep of the shared areas and the pool water is inconsistent at times. The location is also far, so you need a car. Bottom line: good for families or groups of friends with a car who want a room with a kitchen plus a Venice-themed pool on the tightest budget, but you have to choose the rental manager well and read the unit's reviews carefully before booking.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pick only rental managers with good reviews and clear room photos, and avoid units whose reviews mention stains or mould · and because the location is far, drive yourself or be ready to call a Grab every time you head out.
pros: Lowest starting price in the article, from ฿700/night · rooms with kitchens to cook yourself
Venice canal pool, water park, gym, sauna all in one place
Some newly renovated units are clean, nicely decorated and good value (from reviews)
Free parking, good for those driving themselves
cons: Overall score 6.3, lowest in the article — some units have stains, mould, or items not matching the photos
Reaching the manager can be hard in some cases; Wi-Fi is weak in some units
Na Jomtien location is far, you need a car · shared-area upkeep is inconsistent at times

entries.type: Serviced Apartment · units with kitchens on the 21st floor
entries.name: 21st Floor Residence Pattaya
entries.revCount: Units in the R-Con Wongamat building · still few reviews
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Wong Amat · North Pattaya · walk to Wong Amat Beach
entries.addr: 677 Moo 5, Soi Naklua 16, R-Con Wongamat Suite building, 21st floor, Naklua, Bang Lamung (Wong Amat, North Pattaya)
entries.storyHtml: 21st Floor Residence Pattaya is a small stay that sells a simple but appealing idea — around 20 units on the 21st floor of the R-Con Wongamat building in the Wong Amat area, giving the feeling of having your own temporary sea-view condo at a sweet price. What reviews like is that the units have a small kitchen, fridge, air-con and a private balcony, with the high-floor rooms looking out to a sea view from up high, which is hard to find on a budget starting around ฿1,000/night. The Wong Amat area is quiet and calm, within walking distance of the beach, near the Sanctuary of Truth and Naklua Market, a source of fresh seafood. There's free Wi-Fi in every room, a reception desk, laundry service, and managers many say are friendly, helping coordinate check-in and recommending places to visit. Honest caveats, said plainly: because it's many units, room standards and cleanliness aren't consistent, with some reviews knocking cleanliness; the shared facilities are used together with the condo's residents; and the area is quiet enough that calling a ride can mean a long wait at times, so having your own vehicle is more convenient. Another point is that the number of reviews is still small, so the 7.5 score should be read as a trend rather than a settled figure. Best for those who want a room with a kitchen and a sea-view balcony in a quiet area, and understand they're staying in a unit, not a chain hotel.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Specify a high-floor unit facing out to sea right when you book to get a real sea view from the balcony · and because the area is quiet, if you don't have your own vehicle, allow extra time waiting for a Grab, especially during the day.

Rooms have a small kitchen and a sea-view balcony from up high

entries.type: Condo rented by the night · in the Unixx building · small kitchen
entries.name: Unixx South Pattaya by Fern
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.4 · 36 reviews · managed by host Fern
entries.badge: 🏊 Loaded with facilities · rooftop sky pool
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pratumnak Hill · South Pattaya · walk to Bali Hai Pier
tags: 🏊 Large pool + slide + rooftop sky pool
⛴️ Near the pier to Koh Larn
entries.addr: 163 Moo 2, Pratumnak, Nongprue, Bang Lamung · Pattaya
entries.storyHtml: Unixx South Pattaya by Fern is a condo unit rented by the night in Raimon Land's Unixx building at the foot of Pratumnak Hill, selling luxury-condo shared facilities at an accessible price — and that's exactly where reviews call it the best value. What you get is a large pool with a slide, a rooftop sky pool, a rooftop garden, a gym and a sauna, the building's shared facilities that nightly-rental guests can use too. The room itself is a studio of around 22–30 sqm with a small kitchen corner and balcony; some high-floor units face out over Pattaya Bay with a sea view, and there's a 1-bedroom unit for couples or small families. The Pratumnak Hill location has the advantage of being quieter and more private than central Pattaya, while still being near Bali Hai Pier for boats to Koh Larn, and not far from Walking Street. The small in-room kitchen lets you cook yourself, saving money on long stays. Honest caveats: this isn't a hotel, so there's no 24-hour front desk, no breakfast, and cleaning is periodic rather than daily; the arrange-to-pick-up-the-key check-in is less certain than a hotel; room quality isn't the same across units because they belong to various owners; and during long holidays it's busy, so the pool and lifts may mean a wait. Best for those who want full shared facilities and a room with a kitchen in a quiet area of South Pattaya, on a budget starting in the low thousands.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Confirm a clear key-pickup time with the host before you travel, since there's no 24-hour front desk · and if you want a sea view, pick a high-floor sea-view Studio directly. The rooftop sky pool is at its best around sunset.

Accessible price compared with the shared facilities you get
Foot-of-Pratumnak-Hill location, near the pier to Koh Larn and Walking Street
Small in-room kitchen, you can cook yourself, saving money on long stays

entries.type: Budget Serviced Apartment · rooms with built-in kitchens
entries.name: Trebel Pattaya
entries.badge: 🍳 Built-in kitchen · walk to Walking Street
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Soi Buakhao · Central Pattaya · 10 min walk to Walking Street
entries.addr: 111/52 Moo 10, Soi Buakhao, Nongprue, Bang Lamung (Central Pattaya) · Pattaya
entries.storyHtml: Trebel Pattaya is a small budget serviced apartment of just 14 rooms on Soi Buakhao that reviews call a good-value option for long-stayers who want to cook their own food. The clear selling point is that every room has a built-in kitchen, a large fridge and a microwave, which is hard to find in rooms starting around ฿800/night. The Soi Buakhao location is in the middle of central Pattaya, about a 10-minute walk to Walking Street, and near Buakhao Market and the Tops supermarket, making it easy to buy groceries to stock the fridge and cook. Reviews praise the rooms as clean, the Wi-Fi as fast, and the soundproofing as helping cut noise from the lively area. Honest caveats, said plainly: this is a small apartment with no swimming pool, no gym and no breakfast; some rooms have no front window and no balcony, with little natural light; the kitchen equipment isn't fully complete; the building has no lift and no on-site parking; and some staff speak little English, so communication can be a bit slow. The number of reviews is still small at just 8, so the 7.8 score should be read as a trend rather than a settled figure, and you should check the latest reviews before deciding. But for what this price delivers, most reviews still agree it's good value, especially on the clean rooms and a kitchen that genuinely works. Best for budget travellers and long-stayers who value a room with a kitchen and a central-Pattaya location within walking distance of the entertainment and the supermarket, over shared facilities like a pool or gym.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Specify a room with a window or balcony right when you book, since some rooms have little natural light · and stop by Tops or Buakhao Market for ingredients to cook in the kitchen to make the most of this place's strength.

Central-Pattaya location, 10 min walk to Walking Street
Near Buakhao Market and Tops, easy to stock the fridge

entries.type: Condo Resort for rent · tropical lagoon pool
entries.name: Laguna Beach Resort 2
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.4 · resort condo for rent · Jomtien area
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Jomtien · ~600–700 m walk to the beach
entries.addr: Soi Nong Yai, Nong Prue, Bang Lamung (Jomtien) · Pattaya
entries.storyHtml: Laguna Beach Resort 2 is a condo resort for rent in the Jomtien area that sells the picture of "a resort stay on a condo budget" — and the thing reviews mention most is the cluster of pools. It's a large tropical-style lagoon pool with a water park and a kids' pool that really does look resort-grade, letting families with little ones swim all day without going anywhere. Rooms start from a studio of around 24 sqm with a sitting area and built-in kitchen, a private balcony and en-suite bathroom, moving up to a One Bedroom of 36–64 sqm for families. Prices start in the high hundreds per night, from around ฿700, and there's also a monthly-rental option of around ฿9,000–11,000/month that reviews say suits remote workers and long stays. The location is about a 600–700 m walk to Jomtien Beach, and the area is quiet and calm. Honest caveats: this is a rental condo where each room is managed separately, so quality and service aren't as consistent as a hotel; some rooms have an old showerhead or dated equipment, so read the host's reviews before booking; there's no hotel-style breakfast, so you go out to eat or cook yourself; and check-in varies by the renter, with some slow to reply. Another point is that it's not on the beach, so you have to walk or take a ride out. Best for families who want a lovely pool and an in-room kitchen on a budget, in the quiet Jomtien area.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pick a Pool View room so the balcony looks out over the tropical pool cluster, which is this place's highlight · and if you're staying long, ask about the monthly rate, which is much cheaper than booking by the night.

Affordable price from ฿700, with several managers to compare prices

entries.type: Condo-style 4★ · sky pool with sea view
entries.name: Centric Sea Pattaya
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.2 · 640 reviews · rented by the night
entries.badge: 🏙️ Lots of reviews · sky pool with sea view
entries.addr: 268 Soi Pattaya Klang, Central Pattaya Rd, Nong Prue, Bang Lamung · Pattaya
entries.storyHtml: Centric Sea Pattaya is a condo rented by the night in central Pattaya with as many as 640 reviews, the most of any condo in this article, which makes the review picture fairly clear and trustworthy. The selling point every review mentions is the rooftop sky pool with a view over Pattaya Bay, lovely both by day and in the evening, and the sea-facing rooms get the same view. The room itself is a studio of around 25–30 sqm with a small kitchen and balcony, moving up to a 1-bedroom of around 35 sqm with a clearly separate bedroom. Reviews say it's good value over several nights because the in-room kitchen helps save on food costs, and the location is near CentralFestival and restaurants within walking distance, with the beach walkable too, plus parking and free Wi-Fi. Honest caveats: because it's a condo, not a hotel, there's no hotel-style service, so you have to arrange the key pickup with the owner yourself; some rooms have old furniture or broken appliances; cleaning is periodic rather than daily; and prices vary quite a bit by unit because they're rented out by various managers, so read the reviews of the unit you'll book carefully and compare prices across several rooms before deciding. The condo building also has shared-area rules you should ask about in advance. With as many as 640 reviews, the pros and cons are fairly settled and more trustworthy than a small condo with few reviews. Bottom line: good for those who want a room with a kitchen and balcony plus a sky pool with a sea view in central Pattaya on an affordable budget, with the mall and beach walkable, and who are ready to pick a well-reviewed unit themselves.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you want a sea view, pick a sea-view Studio or 1 Bedroom directly, since city-view and sea-view prices differ clearly · and read the reviews of the unit you'll book carefully, since each room is managed separately.
pros: As many as 640 reviews, a clear and trustworthy review picture
Lovely sky pool with a sea view, sea-facing rooms see Pattaya Bay
Room with kitchen saves on food costs, good value over several nights
Near CentralFestival and restaurants within walking distance · parking + free Wi-Fi

entries.name: G Residence Pattaya
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.7 · 409 reviews · in the Diamond Suites condo
entries.badge: 🏊 2 infinity pools · kitchen in every room
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thappraya Road · between South Pattaya and Jomtien
entries.addr: 378/148 Thappraya Road, Soi 15, Nongprue, Bang Lamung · Pattaya
entries.storyHtml: Closing the list is G Residence Pattaya, a 63-room serviced apartment in the Diamond Suites condo on Thappraya Road that reviews call a good-value option for long-stayers and families — and a score of 8.7 from 409 reviews counts as high and trustworthy among the serviced apartments in this article. The selling point is that every room has a built-in kitchen, from a King-bed studio that combines sleeping, sitting and kitchen in an open space, up to 2-bedroom units for families or groups of friends, plus 2 infinity pools, a gym and free parking. The Thappraya Road location sits midway on a hill between South Pattaya and Jomtien; reviews say it's an advantage because you can drop down to either side, songthaews pass by, and the vibe is quieter and more private than the city centre. The in-room kitchen helps save on food costs over several nights, the staff are praised as kind, and the internet is stable. Honest caveats: this is an apartment in the Diamond Suites condo, not a full-service new hotel, so room condition isn't the same across all rooms because they're units; parts of the building are starting to age; the pool cleanliness at times could be kept more consistent; there's no big-hotel-style 24-hour front desk, so some things must be coordinated in advance; and it's not on the beach. Best for families and long-stayers who want a spacious room with a kitchen plus a pool, in a quiet area that drops down to both Jomtien and South Pattaya.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're coming as a family, pick One Bedroom or up for a separate bedroom and a full kitchen · and because it's on Thappraya hill, having your own vehicle or renting a motorbike is more convenient than waiting for a songthaew.

From Bangkok it's about 1.5–2 hours · Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — questions travellers often ask about apartment-style stays in Pattaya

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best apartment-style stay in Pattaya?
faq.a: It depends on your trip style · if you measure by score and beachfront sea view, Sea View Beachfront Condos Jomtien scores 9.2, the highest in the article · if you want to sleep right on the beach on a light budget, Sky Beach Apartment is a 1-min walk to the sand · if you want a spacious room with a kitchen at good value, View Talay Residence 6 or G Residence · if you focus on lovely shared facilities loaded with pools, Unixx South Pattaya or Laguna Beach Resort 2

faq.q: ❓ How much do apartment-style stays in Pattaya cost?
faq.a: In this article, prices start at around ฿700–2,500 per night · the cheapest are Venetian and Laguna Beach Resort 2 from ฿700, and Trebel from ฿800 · the mid-range, around ฿1,000–1,300, are 21st Floor, Unixx, G Residence, Sky Beach, View Talay 6 and Centric Sea · the top of the article is Sea View Beachfront Condos from ฿2,500 (beachfront sea view) · prices during high season and long holidays may be higher than usual

faq.q: ❓ How do apartment-style stays differ from hotels · who are they for?
faq.a: Most apartment-style stays are condos or apartments rented out by various managers. The strengths are larger rooms and an in-room kitchen so you can cook yourself, which makes them good for long-stayers, families, and groups of friends who want to save on food · the trade-off is they often have no 24-hour front desk, no breakfast, periodic cleaning, and room standards that vary by unit · if you want full hotel-style service, consider a chain hotel instead

faq.q: ❓ Which area is best for an apartment in Pattaya?
faq.a: Jomtien Beach, a long quiet beach good for families, with sea-view condos and resort condos with lovely pools (Sea View Beachfront Condos, Laguna Beach Resort 2) · Wong Amat Beach (Naklua), North Pattaya, a calm vibe, near the seafood market (Sky Beach, View Talay 6, 21st Floor) · Central Pattaya, near the mall and Walking Street, everything walkable (Trebel, Centric Sea) · Pratumnak Hill–Thappraya, quiet and private (Unixx, G Residence)

faq.q: ❓ Which apartment-style stays in Pattaya suit families and long stays?
faq.a: Those with an in-room kitchen and spacious space are best · View Talay Residence 6 and G Residence have spacious rooms with kitchens and multi-bedroom units · Sky Beach has 2–3 bedroom units of 106–123 sqm · Laguna Beach Resort 2 has a kids' pool and water park good for families with little ones, plus a monthly-rental option for long stays

faq.q: ❓ What should you watch out for in particular when booking an apartment in Pattaya?
faq.a: Because most are condos rented out by various managers, standards vary by unit · you should read the reviews and look at the photos of the unit you'll book carefully and choose a well-reviewed manager · confirm the key-pickup or check-in time in advance, since many have no 24-hour front desk · check that the kitchen, Wi-Fi and parking are as you need · and pick Free Cancellation first if your plans aren't settled, then compare Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price
